events.text: Frank Robert Miller was born in Kamloops, British Columbia.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Frank Robert Miller was born in Kamloops , British Columbia , on April 30 , 1908

events.text: Miller joined the Royal Canadian Air Force at Camp Borden with the rank of pilot officer.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Miller joined the Royal Canadian Air Force at Camp Borden on September 15 , 1931 , with the rank of pilot officer

events.text: He received his wings.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He received his wings on December 16

events.text: Miller became an instructor at the Camp Borden flying and navigation school.
events.subject: self
events.object: Camp Borden flying and navigation school
events.quote: becoming an instructor at the Camp Borden flying and navigation school in 1935

events.text: Miller was promoted to flight lieutenant.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Promoted to flight lieutenant on September 1 , 1937

events.text: He taught at the Air Navigation and Seaplane School, Trenton.
events.subject: self
events.object: Air Navigation and Seaplane School, Trenton
events.quote: he taught at the Air Navigation and Seaplane School , Trenton from May 1937

events.text: His teaching at the Air Navigation and Seaplane School, Trenton ended.
events.subject: self
events.object: Air Navigation and Seaplane School, Trenton
events.quote: from May 1937 to September 1938

events.text: Miller was posted to England to attend the Specialist Air Navigation Course at the School of Air Navigation, RAF Manston.
events.subject: self
events.object: School of Air Navigation, RAF Manston
events.quote: In September 1938 , Miller was posted to England to attend the Specialist Air Navigation Course

events.text: Miller was promoted to squadron leader.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he was promoted to squadron leader on April 1 , 1939

events.text: Miller was the Officer Commanding of the Air Navigation and Reconnaissance School, Trenton at the outbreak of war.
events.subject: self
events.object: Air Navigation and Reconnaissance School, Trenton
events.quote: At the outbreak of war in September , Miller was the Officer Commanding of the Air Navigation and Reconnaissance School , Trenton

events.text: He was promoted to acting wing commander.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was promoted to acting wing commander in December 1940

events.text: Miller commanded the Air Navigation School at Rivers, Manitoba.
events.subject: self
events.object: Air Navigation School at Rivers, Manitoba
events.quote: From May 1942 Miller commanded the Air Navigation School at Rivers , Manitoba

events.text: He was promoted to acting group captain.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Promoted to acting group captain in July

events.text: Miller moved to the Air Force Headquarters where he served as Director of Training Plans and Requirements.
events.subject: self
events.quote: moving to the Air Force Headquarters in January 1943 where he served as Director of Training Plans and Requirements

events.text: He was promoted to acting air commodore.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was promoted to acting air commodore in January 1943

events.text: Miller was posted to England.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1944 Miller was posted to England

events.text: Miller took up command of RAF Bomber Command's No. 61 Base in North Yorkshire.
events.subject: self
events.quote: on September 19 he took up command of RAF Bomber Commands No . 61 Base in North Yorkshire

events.text: Miller held the substantive rank of air commodore.
events.subject: self
events.quote: with the substantive rank of air commodore from October 14

events.text: Miller's command was redesignated No. 76 Base.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On November 9 Millars command was redesignated No . 76 Base

events.text: Miller took up command of No. 63 Base.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On January 13 , 1945 , Miller took up command of No . 63 Base

events.text: Miller was promoted to Vice-Chief of the Air Staff with the rank of air vice-marshal.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In September 1951 , Miller was promoted to Vice-Chief of the Air Staff with the rank of air vice-marshal

events.text: Miller's service as Vice-Chief of the Air Staff ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: serving until 1954

events.text: Miller was posted to Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe as General Lauris Norstad's Vice-Deputy Air.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was then posted to Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe as General Lauris Norstad’s Vice-Deputy Air

events.text: Miller gained promotion to air marshal.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Gaining promotion to air marshal in 1955

events.text: Miller retired from the RCAF to serve as Deputy Minister of National Defence.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he then retired from the RCAF at Prime Minister Louis St . Laurents request to serve in the senior civil service position of Deputy Minister of National Defence

events.text: Miller remained in the post of Deputy Minister of National Defence until 1957.
events.subject: self
events.quote: remaining in post until 1957

events.text: Miller became Deputy Commander-in-Chief NORAD.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He then became Deputy Commander-in-Chief NORAD

events.text: Miller was appointed Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff.
events.subject: self
events.object: Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff
events.quote: In 1960 he was appointed Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff

events.text: Miller was promoted to air chief marshal.
events.subject: self
events.quote: gaining promotion to air chief marshal on 1 September 1961

events.text: Miller became the first Chief of the Defence Staff.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he became the first Chief of the Defence Staff , serving from 1964

events.text: Miller's service as Chief of the Defence Staff ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: serving from 1964 until 1966

events.text: Miller resigned in protest.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in 1966 resigned in protest

events.text: Miller was made a Companion of the Order of Canada.
events.subject: self
events.object: Companion of the Order of Canada
events.quote: In 1972 Miller was made a Companion of the Order of Canada .

events.text: Miller died.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He died on October 20 , 1997 .
